notes: 15 derivative *written* design briefs do not replace canonical skin grammar or signify art/image assets.
Each skin minimum is its distinctive direction/recipe rather than requiring ten binary assets or full per-skin logo.
No screenshots, separate vector source, PNG, font, audio or approved wordmark created.
